snippet.title: VOTOMS Gaiden: Blue Knight Berserga Story (PSX) - Zerberus Gameplay
snippet.description:
Probably the only videogame appearance of the elusive Calamitydog "Blue Version", the Zerberus. It's a next-generation experimental AT, model number ATM-FX-1. It's the first of three units, the others being the Green and Red versions.

This is a fanservice of sorts, because the Zerberus is piloted by Chris Katze in this game, but the novel version is piloted by Kain McDougal (main character of the Berserga novels) in a period after Katze has already died. Or that's what I've gathered from Tim Eldred's VOTOMS guide, so correct me if I'm wrong.
